1bdd7e9b-bb7e-5fc8-8921-b2b119d6c0ce.content: Mark the most recent verification time on content that changes over time.

9a714945-c9d9-50d1-9426-e7f8604881dc.content: Do not establish either side of an unresolved Memory conflict as the current fact.

1b94d2b9-7a00-5a13-8e51-e45cfa59bcc4.content: Keep the local Memories supporting each sharing candidate traceable.

2fc77298-47bc-5bf8-a631-e9c5d6514d69.content: If a fact changes after a Memory is recorded but the source Memory is not updated, the sharing candidate retains the earlier state.

bcd9bfa6-ee3b-5563-8500-cab9b88978dd.content: A receiving agent may interpret unmarked uncertainty as a verified fact.
